question.body:
Let $f$ be the function satisfying $f'(x)= x sqrt(f(x))$ for all real numbers $x$, where $f(3)= 25$.

(a) Find $f''(3)$.

(b) Write an expression for $y = f(x)$ by solving the differential equation $frac(d y,d x)= x sqrt(y)$ with the initial condition $f(3)= 25$.
